_about: The animated backgrounds a film can stand on. Each is a component in engine/src/kit/backgrounds, used as the bottom layer inside a <Stage>. The engine reads this file to build the "Backgrounds" reel and one "bg-<name>" composition per entry, so an entry here is all a new background needs to show up there. How to use and add one is in README.md; how much each one moves at each energy is in measured.json. Keys that start with an underscore are notes for people.

_shared_props.energy: "rest" (the default: drifts so slowly that tools/study/profile.py measures the frame as still), "alive" (a drift the eye can follow when it looks for it) or "peak" (about twice alive). Set once per film, or changed on a cut.
_shared_props.seed: A number, default 1. Changes where everything starts, so two films with the same background do not match.
_shared_props.over: Moving treatments only. true lays the treatment over another background, without its own page colour. Default false.

backgrounds.name: paper
backgrounds.label: Paper
backgrounds.looks: A calm light page with one soft light from the upper left and a faint cool bounce from the opposite corner.
backgrounds._pages: Light page only. Paper is the light page's own stage: on a dark page one soft light with no accent is simply a dimmer Night, so use Night there.

backgrounds.name: night
backgrounds.label: Night
backgrounds.looks: The dark page with slow pools of the soft fill and the accent, like light in a dark room.
backgrounds._pages: Dark page only. Night is the dark page's own stage: pools of light need darkness to read, and on a light page they are only a pale wash, so use Paper there.

backgrounds.name: glass
backgrounds.label: Glass
backgrounds.looks: Four translucent panes at different depths around the edges, with a slow band of light passing through them and a thin bright line on each top edge.

backgrounds.name: colour-field
backgrounds.label: Colour field
backgrounds.looks: The accent colour edge to edge, with deeper and lighter tones of it moving slowly and one soft round shape in the lower right corner.
backgrounds._content_on: Type on this background takes the stage's onAccent colour, not its ink.

backgrounds.name: editorial
backgrounds.label: Editorial
backgrounds.looks: A page with generous margins marked by thin rules and short column marks, and one slow band of light crossing it.

backgrounds.name: blueprint
backgrounds.label: Blueprint
backgrounds.looks: Thin solid construction lines and two compass arcs in the line colour, with one accent path that draws itself around the edge of the frame.

backgrounds.name: aurora
backgrounds.label: Aurora
backgrounds.looks: Slow, soft ribbons of the accent and second colours flowing across the top and the foot of the frame.

backgrounds.name: horizon
backgrounds.label: Horizon
backgrounds.looks: A wide arc of light rising from the bottom edge, like the rim of a planet, with a glow above it that glides along the rim.

props.rise: 0 (below the edge) to 1 (fully risen, the default). Animate it to bring the light up.

backgrounds.name: waves
backgrounds.label: Waves
backgrounds.looks: Five thin flowing lines in the accent and second colours across the foot of the frame.

backgrounds.name: spotlight
backgrounds.label: Spotlight
backgrounds.looks: One soft light on the page, with the page falling into shade around it. It rests a little above the middle, or follows a point the scene gives it.

props.point: { x, y } in frame pixels, the same places a Cursor uses. Left out, a little above the middle.
props.size: How far the light reaches, as a share of frame height. Default 0.75.

backgrounds.name: perspective-lines
backgrounds.label: Perspective lines
backgrounds.looks: A quiet floor of solid lines running to one vanishing point, with cross lines coming slowly towards the viewer and a haze of light at the horizon.

backgrounds.name: soft-shapes
backgrounds.label: Soft shapes
backgrounds.looks: A circle, a rounded square and a long pill in the soft fill, the accent and a tone between the two, out of focus and drifting at the corners.

_reviewed: All twelve were watched moving and measured at the three energies on 2026-11-11, for the brands tulvo and demo.
